description: Land a self-driven, self-healing Orleans cluster-singleton event dispatcher that pulls undelivered event rows from all four truth tables each tick, fans them out by type to matching [Subscription] handlers with per-handler retry, dead-letters poison messages, and marks each row delivered — reactivating the dormant cross-aggregate reactions. Re-creates the DeadLetters persistence layer as a prerequisite.

tasks.title: Re-create the DeadLetters persistence layer
tasks.description: Re-introduce the DeadLetters persistence layer deleted in ba50c2089. Add a DeadLetterRow entity (PK DeadLetterId; event snapshot Origin/Id/Source/EventId/Type/Time/SpecVersion/Subject/DataContentType/Data/ExtensionsJson; plus FailingHandler/Error/Reason/AttemptCount/DeadLetteredAt) with a DeadLetters DbSet in MohistDbContext (indexes on DeadLetteredAt and (FailingHandler, DeadLetteredAt)), an IDeadLetterStore (WriteAsync / QueryAsync with failing-handler filter / GetAsync by id / DeleteAsync after successful recovery) backed by DeadLetterStore plus a NoopDeadLetterStore test fake, and one EF migration creating the table. This is a self-contained persistence + query module that the dispatcher (T-002) consumes on poison-message exhaustion and for manual re-delivery.
acceptanceCriteria: DeadLetterRow entity exists and DeadLetters DbSet is registered in MohistDbContext with PK DeadLetterId and indexes HasIndex(DeadLetteredAt) and HasIndex(FailingHandler, DeadLetteredAt).
A new EF migration creates the DeadLetters table with the above indexes; the migration applies cleanly against MigratedSqliteTemplate and MohistDbContextModelSnapshot is consistent (no model drift).

IDeadLetterStore is implemented by DeadLetterStore exposing WriteAsync(DeadLetterRow), QueryAsync(string? failingHandler, int limit), GetAsync(long deadLetterId), and DeleteAsync(long deadLetterId); NoopDeadLetterStore is provided as the test fake and registered via TryAdd so tests can override it.

WriteAsync persists a row; QueryAsync returns rows (ordered by DeadLetteredAt) and narrows by FailingHandler when the filter is supplied; GetAsync retrieves a single row by DeadLetterId; DeleteAsync removes a resolved row.
Store tests cover write, query (with and without handler filter), get-by-id, and delete; the server test suite (npm test) is green and TreatWarningsAsErrors stays clean.
tasks.output: Infrastructure/Data/Events/DeadLetterRow.cs, Infrastructure/Events/IDeadLetterStore.cs, Infrastructure/Data/Events/DeadLetterStore.cs, a NoopDeadLetterStore fake, MohistDbContext DeadLetters registration, one new EF migration, and store tests (unit/spec).
tasks.notes: Model the row on the historical shape deleted in ba50c2089, but extend Origin handling to include AgentSession (the historical ParseOrigin only covered WorkflowRun/Issue/Epic). The three migration .Designer.cs snapshots that still reference DeadLetterRow are frozen historical artifacts and do NOT participate in EF diffing — only MohistDbContextModelSnapshot.cs does, and it is clean of DeadLetter, so the new migration will be a clean CreateTable. DispatchedAt already exists on all four event truth tables, so this task touches only the DeadLetters table.

tasks.title: Implement the self-driven cluster-singleton event dispatcher
tasks.description: Build the sole, self-healing notifier as an Orleans cluster-singleton grain that is a thin shell over a pure-DI fan-out service. Add IDispatcherGrain (IGrainWithStringKey + IRemindable, fixed key "dispatcher") that registers a ~1s persisted reminder on activation and delegates ReceiveReminder and PulseAsync to EventDispatcherService.DispatchAsync. EventDispatcherService (silo-container singleton) pulls via IEventStore.ListUndeliveredAsync, fans each event out by type using CloudEventTypeMatcher over the registered IEnumerable<Subscription>, invokes matching DispatchDelegates with per-handler retry (fixed attempt cap, hand-rolled — no Polly), writes a DeadLetterRow and sets DispatchedAt on exhaustion, and marks each row DispatchedAt (from injected TimeProvider) only after all matching handlers settle; processing is serial in (Source, Id) order. Also fix handler discovery and filter invocation, inject TimeProvider into InMemoryEventBus (remove DateTimeOffset.UtcNow), register the service/store/grain in the silo container, activate the dispatcher on fresh host startup, and add operator API/CLI recovery that retries only the handler recorded by a dead-letter row.
acceptanceCriteria: IDispatcherGrain (IGrainWithStringKey, IRemindable) and DispatcherGrain exist with fixed key "dispatcher"; the grain registers a persisted reminder (~1s, cadence configurable) on activation, and both ReceiveReminder and PulseAsync run exactly one pull–fan-out–mark cycle by delegating to EventDispatcherService.DispatchAsync.

DispatcherActivationService activates the fixed-key grain during host startup, and an integration spec verifies that a fresh host has registered the dispatcher reminder without an explicit producer Pulse.

EventDispatcherService is a plain DI singleton taking IEventStore, IEnumerable<Subscription>, IDeadLetterStore, TimeProvider, ILogger; every DispatchedAt/DeadLetteredAt timestamp is sourced from the injected TimeProvider (no DateTimeOffset.UtcNow in the dispatch path).

Each tick calls IEventStore.ListUndeliveredAsync (the single UNION over WorkflowRun/Issue/Epic/AgentSession truth tables), processes the batch serially in (Source, Id) order, and applies CloudEventTypeMatcher.Matches(subscription.Type, event.Type) to decide fan-out per subscription.

Per-handler retry uses a fixed attempt cap: a transient handler failure is retried and, on eventual success, the event is delivered for that handler; when a handler's retries exhaust, a DeadLetterRow (FailingHandler + error + attempt count) is written via IDeadLetterStore and the original event row's DispatchedAt is set so the dispatcher stops retrying it.
Per-handler isolation holds: when an event matches two handlers and one exhausts, the sibling handler still receives the event independently and its outcome does not depend on the failing handler.
Per-row DispatchedAt is set only after all matching handlers have settled (succeeded or dead-lettered); no undelivered row is marked before delivery.
A MarkDispatchedAsync failure propagates and stops the current batch so a higher row in the same stream cannot overtake the unmarked row.

The closed-generic discovery bug in AddCloudEventHandlersFromAssembly is fixed (proper ICloudEventHandler<> closed-generic scan) so EpicAutoDoneHandler and EpicCancelledReconcileHandler are registered and invoked in the fan-out.
InMemoryEventBus no longer reads DateTimeOffset.UtcNow; it uses an injected TimeProvider for the envelope timestamp.

RedeliverAsync(deadLetterId) retries only the failing handler recorded by the dead-letter row, never repeats successful siblings, deletes the row on success, and remains available through the server API and mo CLI.

Required production handler side effects are awaited and propagate failure to the dispatcher; Agent subscription launches use stable session/job identities and identical AgentJob submissions are idempotent.
EventDispatcherService, IDeadLetterStore→DeadLetterStore (with NoopDeadLetterStore via TryAdd), and the dispatcher grain are registered in the silo container (MohistSiloRegistration).

Unit tests (fake IEventStore + fake/Noop IDeadLetterStore + FakeTimeProvider) cover: pull→match→invoke→mark; per-stream FIFO (Source,Id) ordering with no skip; per-handler retry-then-succeed; exhaustion → dead-letter written + DispatchedAt set + not retried next tick; per-handler isolation; deliver-before-mark crash → row stays undelivered → re-delivered on next tick; CloudEventTypeMatcher fan-out including a closed-generic handler.

Spec/integration tests (WorkflowGrainFixture or MohistIntegrationFixture) cover: an appended event is delivered after a reminder tick (or Pulse); Pulse triggers an immediate tick; a closed-generic Epic handler is invoked on a matching event.
Server npm test is green and TreatWarningsAsErrors stays clean.
tasks.output: IDispatcherGrain.cs, DispatcherGrain.cs, DispatcherActivationService.cs, EventDispatcherService.cs, handler outcome/idempotency hardening, the discovery/filter fix in CloudEventBusServiceCollectionExtensions.cs, the InMemoryEventBus TimeProvider edit, silo/host registrations, DeadLetterRoutes + mo event dead-letter commands, and unit + spec/integration/CLI tests.
tasks.notes: Follow design.md decisions D1–D11. Retry is hand-rolled with a fixed attempt cap and NO backoff/jitter in v1 (D6) — do NOT add Polly. Grain registration does not activate the fixed key: host startup must call EnsureStartedAsync so a fresh reminder table begins ticking without Pulse. Handler Tasks are the delivery-result authority and required side effects must propagate failure. MarkDispatched failure stops the batch. Agent subscription launches reuse stable session/job identities. Manual dead-letter recovery retries only the recorded failing handler and is exposed through API + mo CLI.
